correctness.rationale: The exact expected-count inclusion-exclusion formula accounts for persistent carcass survival and duplicate detections. Its derivative makes the last survey terminal and the first objective strictly unimodal. Tilted-exponential hazard differentiation gives negative variance, yielding a strictly increasing optimal skew. Strict convexity of the mean-normalized survival ratio gives one positive persistence crossover and sharp detector-quality boundary; skew limits and monotonicity then give the globally unique horizon reversal and all equality cases. The exact two-rate polynomial/logarithmic example is directly verified. Standalone checker.py passed 60064 supplementary numerical assertions; they do not substitute for the continuum proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The related two-visit Markov model permits recolonization; its state availability process does not have a permanently removed carcass with a strictly decreasing survival hazard, so its constant post-threshold offset does not imply the strictly increasing mixture skew. The Gamma-detectability economic stopping theorem compares costs and one search duration, not positions of two instantaneous surveys, and its latent heterogeneity is in detection not survival. A broad uninspected optimal-inspection result could potentially dominate the present claim, which remains the main historical priority risk.

General earlier optimal-inspection and survival-mixture literature is not exhaustively inspected; historical priority beyond named material remains provisional.
A general formula for carcass detection under irregular survey intervals is established prior art. The assessed novelty is only the additional sharp comparison of the optimized dates.

value.rationale: The 2021 roadkill study motivates balancing carcass survival against survey effort and finds meaningful taxon-dependent persistence. An analytically sharp boundary says precisely when fitting only the mean lifetime can misplace the earlier of two surveys in a single direction versus reverse that error at a unique horizon, while retaining the same mean. The observable objective is expected distinct detections or at-least-one detection, so the orientation has direct methodological interpretation. The theorem is a self-contained mathematical benchmark requiring calibration before ecological use; it is neither a textbook renaming nor an arbitrary extra decimal.
